# Real CV layouts (synthetic content)

Each file reproduces the *layout* of a CV that broke the parser during QA Phase 1, as the text
looks after PDF extraction. The people, companies, campuses, dates and contact details are
invented. No real CV is stored in this repository.

| File | Layout it reproduces |
| --- | --- |
| `inline_headings.txt` | Job-portal export: the heading shares a line with its first entry, the job title sits above the dates, and a duration in brackets follows them |
| `plural_headings.txt` | "EXPERIENCES", employer and role on separate lines around the dates, an "ORGANIZATIONAL EXPERIENCE" section |
| `company_first.txt` | "Company, Role 2023 - Present", a degree still in progress, a misspelt tool name |
| `heading_variants.txt` | "Work Experiences", "Education Level", company and city on the date line with the role underneath |
| `spaced_headings.txt` | Letter-spaced headings, a "PROJECT :" sub-heading inside a job, two interleaved columns |
